title: Patimbul Be Ma Sangap
chord: Eb · G · Am · F · C · G · F · Eb
lyrics:
Huhalashon, huringkoti
HaroroM tu tano on
Jesus Sipalua hami
Jolma na mardangol on
Ai marhite mudarMi
Dihophopi Ho do i

HuriaM asa badia
Jala dohot marmulia
Sai na di joloM do jongjong
HuriaM na lea i
Ai ringkot dihalungunhon
Naeng tu Ho Rajana i

Dipaimaima Ho
Jala tung marhobas do
Mangihuthon Ho Parmonang
ToguonMu tu na sonang
Ro sai ro Ho, o Tuhanku
Jesus ro ma Ho tibu

I panjou ni oroanmu
Na malungun situtu
Ro ma Ho O Jesuski
Tatap haporsuhonki
Sai tu hasampuran rea
AlaponMu na porsea
